column2: Average Monthly Household Expenditure Among Resident Households by Income Quintile and Type of Dwelling

column4: 2/ It is notable that some resident households in the lowest 20% income group owned a car (10.2%), employed a domestic helper (7.2%), lived in private property (4.5%) or were with household reference persons aged 65 years and over (27.5%) in 2007/08.
